newsitem.title: UK: BA's says problem solved on Boeing 777s.
newsitem.headline: BA's says problem solved on Boeing 777s.

text.p: British Airways Plc said on Friday that it expects to put its new Boeing 777 twinjet aircraft back on transatlantic service within the next 10 days, after solving engine "teething problems".

The airline said it had moved the three twinjets off long range operations over water onto European and middle eastern routes at the beginning of March after engineers suspected there had been excessive wear in some gearbox bearings in the General Electric GE-90 engines.

"We took a decision to withdraw them from transatlantic routes as a precaution because of some teething problems," a spokesman said. "A solution for this has been identified by our engineers and is being implemented to have them back in extended range operation within the next 10 days."
